crossRefs.note: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of…

people.name: Adummim
people.line: A pass on the border between Judah and Benjamin.

people.name: Bohan
people.line: Reubenite after whom a boundary stone was named

people.name: En-shemesh
people.line: Spring on the border between Judah and Benjamin

people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
translations.bsb: From there it curved northward and proceeded to En-shemesh and on to Geliloth facing the Ascent of Adummim, and continued down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
translations.kjv: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to Enshemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
translations.asv: and it extended northward, and went out at En-shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is over against the ascent of Adummim; and it went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben;
